thread:
Elliott: Bringing up new Thalassa-11B int4 on prod-nf4; quick eval shows a nasty summary quality regression vs fp16 (ROUGE-L ~36.5 -> 30.4).
Priya: Any diffs in tokenization? We saw weird BOS id remaps on earlier converts.
Elliott: Tokenizer token ids mostly match but tokenmap_diff produced ~180 mismatches concentrated in low ids and a set of combining marks. Converter reported it normalized to NFKD. Original hf tokenizer uses NFKC.
Noah: That explains merged-token differences. Normalization change shifts token boundaries -> KV cache will desync.
Elliott: Runtime log also emitted: "kv_cache_offset=257 expected=256" and loader warned that checkpoint had key "rotary_scale_v1" while runtime expects "rotary_phase_scale". It defaulted to 1.0.
Priya: Two orthogonal failure modes then: token-id drift from normalization + rotary metadata mismatch causing kernel selection difference.
Kai: Quick tests? Try (A) force fp16 rotary_phase into int4 runtime; (B) run with prefix-cache disabled; (C) use fp16 tokenmap for tokenization.
Elliott: Ran all three combos. Forcing rotary recovers ~+2.5 ROUGE; disabling prefix-cache recovers ~+1.1; swapping tokenmap recovers ~+3.0. Forcing both rotary+tokenmap gets within 0.2 of fp16 baseline.
Noah: Sounds additive. Converter needs a preserve-normalization flag and consistent rotary key naming.
Priya: I'll open a runtime PR to fail loudly if rotary metadata missing and to log selected kernel variant. Silent defaults are dangerous.
Kai: I'll create a converter issue and PR draft: add --preserve-nfkc and ensure merge-table ordering is stable across conversions.
ops-bot: Job queued: thalassa-int4-bisect-171780 (id: job-7901). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/7901/logs
Elliott: For the bisect job please include KV dumps for first 4 steps and token id arrays for each prompt. Also capture attention-phase matrices for layer 0/1.
Noah: I'll add a debug hook to emit rotary phase matrices (debug-only). Keep it minimal.
Priya: Also add tokenmap roundtrip test to onboarding: hf tokenizer -> converter -> loader and assert id equality for a 5k-sentence sample.
Elliott: Owners: Priya (runtime fix + onboarding test), Kai (converter PR), Noah (rotary dump), Elliott (eval bisect and mitigation note).
Kai: For customer safety, gate the int4 nf4 profile behind feature flag until fixes land.
Elliott: Agreed. I'll draft a short mitigation blurb for support and update Dedicated config.
ops-bot: Job 7901 finished: preliminary dumps show phase mismatch in cache when token ids shift by 1. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/7901/dumps.tar.gz
Priya: I'll push a runtime hotfix to fail on missing rotary key and to allow forcing rotary_phase via env var.
Kai: Converter PR up in draft: preserve-nfkc and consistent rotary key mapping.
Elliott: Thanks team. Will post minimal repro (prompt + ids + KV dumps) once we have PRs merged and a green bisect run.
